_comment: Staged CI enforcement (2026-07-25) for the Telegram delivery gateway migration. This repo is a single file (index.js), so unlike flexai-saas's per-file allowlist, LEGACY (pending-migration) growth is tracked by a simple call-site COUNT of `await sendTelegram(` / `await sendTelegramWithId(` calls, EXCLUDING any call site explicitly marked as a named exception (see telegram-direct-send-exceptions.json -- those are checked separately, for an exact 1:1 match, not folded into this count). The count must never INCREASE from this baseline -- it should only go DOWN as senders migrate one at a time. A new direct sendTelegram call site (growth) fails the deploy check; migrating an existing one off direct-send requires lowering this baseline deliberately in the same commit, as proof the reduction was intentional and reviewed, not accidental. DELIBERATE INCREASE (2026-07-29, 32->36): the ORB FOCUS SYSTEM (runOrbPlannerV2/runOrbFocusPlannerV2) added 4 new admin-only sends -- the Phase 2 ORB FOCUS digest message (a multi-symbol picks digest, structurally the same class of message as runMasterWatchlistV2's own WATCH LIST send, which is ALSO plain direct-send within this same baseline, not a named exception) plus 3 plain internal ops-failure/status notifications (no dedup/entity/evidence concept, same class as v2AlertMasterWatchlistFailure's existing siblings). Consistent with the existing pattern for this class of message, not routed through the gateway (built for single-symbol structured trading alerts) and not registered as named exceptions (reserved for the gateway-issue-notification's genuinely-no-other-channel case). DELIBERATE INCREASE (2026-08-05, 36->37): runMasterWatchlistV2's new hard-deadline abort path (v2AbortMasterWatchlistOnDeadline, FIX 2 of the master-watchlist observability/deadline round) sends one 'MASTER WATCHLIST TIMED OUT' admin alert -- same class as v2AlertMasterWatchlistFailure's existing siblings (plain internal ops/status notification, no dedup/entity/evidence concept), not a named exception for the same reason those aren't. DELIBERATE DECREASE (2026-08-06, 37->36, Codex review): the flexai-saas Telegram gateway gained a new 'system_event' alertType specifically for this class of plain ops/status notification (lib/telegramGateway/schema.ts + render.ts), and the 'MASTER WATCHLIST TIMED OUT' alert from the prior round -- plus this round's new 'Watchlist delivery unknown' alert -- both now route through gatewaySendTelegram via v2SendMasterWatchlistSystemEvent instead of direct sendTelegram. Net effect: back to 36 (the timeout alert's prior +1 is removed; the new delivery_unknown alert was never direct-send, so it adds nothing). DELIBERATE INCREASE (2026-07-30 evening, 36->38, critical architecture change): the new PRE-FOCUS SELECTOR stage (runPreFocusSelectorV2, 8:35am ET) added 2 new admin-only sends -- the PRE-FOCUS digest message (a 2-symbol picks digest, structurally the same class of message as the existing ORB FOCUS / Master Watchlist WATCH LIST sends, which are ALSO plain direct-send within this same baseline, not named exceptions) plus 1 plain internal error-path notification (same class as runOrbPlannerV2/runOrbFocusPlannerV2's own catch-block sends). runOrbFocusPlannerV2 itself was fully rewritten this same round (reads v2:orb:prefocus:{date} instead of v2:orb:plan:{date}, drops score-based re-ranking) but its own call-site count is unchanged (still 3: suppressed, confirmed, error). DELIBERATE DECREASE (2026-07-31, 38->36, explicit fix request): the prior round's 2 PRE-FOCUS direct sends were flagged as a regression the same evening -- both (plus the new deadline-suppression alert added the same round) now route through gatewaySendTelegram as a 'system_event' via a new v2SendPreFocusSystemEvent helper, the exact same pattern v2SendMasterWatchlistSystemEvent already established for Master Watchlist's own ops notifications. Net effect: back to 36, with zero new direct-send call sites and zero new named exceptions -- the pre-focus digest, its error path, AND its new suppression alert are all gateway-routed, not just the two originally called out.
